title: 工程基线（跨能力）
note: Architecture decisions that hold for EVERY implementation work package, with no owning capability. Keep this stable: it is read once per agent/session and then reused, so it must not be duplicated into per-UC briefs. Capability-specific ADRs do not belong here: ADR-001 (Scope Catalog) goes to the scope-touching UC specs, ADR-002 (publication partition) to the publication UCs, ADR-006 (proto/API repo) to transport packages. A quick filter: if the baseline line would be irrelevant to some package, it belongs with that capability instead.
